disclaimer: Platform-informed screening simulation based on public SAP documentation. AI-assisted screening is licensed and configured separately; it is not assumed to be enabled.

scenarios.title: Traditional recruiter screening
scenarios.description: Recruiters review the application in the Applicant Workbench and move it through configured statuses.

scenarios.title: Employer-configured screening criteria
scenarios.description: Prescreen questions may award weighted points, apply a threshold or disqualify based on answers.

scenarios.title: Candidate profile from parsed resume
scenarios.description: Classic parsing populates standard profile fields; it is not matching or ranking.

scenarios.title: Optional AI-assisted applicant screening
scenarios.description: If licensed and eligible, Skill Compatibility shows matching, relevant and unmatched skills to support recruiter judgment.
